title: ChatGPT Health Adds Read-Only Epic Data Access for Clinicians
dek: OpenAI says clinicians using ChatGPT Health can now import patient data from Epic, bringing read-only health-record access into its product.
socialCaption: OpenAI says ChatGPT Health now integrates with Epic to give clinicians read-only access to patient records for import. The practical test: whether it fits clinical workflows without adding review and governance overhead.
